lines.en: My wheels jolt over the stones.
I am hauled to the gun emplacement.
My barrel points at the wall.
My spokes turn slowly.

lines.zh: 火药的味道一直跟着我
lines.en: The smell of powder follows me.
I am dragged up the slope.

lines.zh: 车架在石头上磕了一下
lines.en: My carriage knocks against a stone.
I am heavy enough to sink the road.
I shift forward half a rod.
My muzzle sways with the carriage.
The tow ropes are pulled taut.
I can see the breach in the wall.
My muzzle rests, silent.
Powder sleeps in my bore.
I wait for the order to load.
The iron fittings rattle.
My wheel is caught in a crack.
Someone is swabbing my bore.

lines.zh: 炮管还留着上次的烟味
lines.en: My barrel still smells of the last shot.
I am waiting for a match.
The wind carries off the smoke at my muzzle.
I need not be understood.
My arc covers that tower.
My breech sits firm.
I am only a length of iron.
I rest on my wooden mount.
You stand before the muzzle.
Stand aside first.
Do you hold a match?
I know the loading motions.
You mean to fire me.
Swab first, then powder.
You are standing on my carriage.
Iron like me answers only to handling.
Do not poke your fingers in my muzzle.
My recoil is fierce; stand clear.

lines.zh: 炮膛里还留着上一发的热气。
lines.en: The heat of the last shot still sits in my bore.
This is not a thing to nudge.

lines.zh: 我被人占领了,就听人的
lines.en: Claimed, I obey.
Can you stand the sound?
Aim the muzzle at that wall.
Push me a little left.
Do not bring the match too close.
You want to hear it roar once.
My carriage has cracked.
My muzzle is skewed.
A dent has been struck in my iron.
One spoke has broken.
That will need the gun re-sighted.
My recoil mount has loosened.
I can roar once more.
Iron feels no pain, but hates misalignment.
Someone is cursing; not I.
Swab it, then start again.
This iron of mine does not eat.
Give me powder; that is more to the point.
That will not fit my bore.
A solid shot is what I want.
That in your hand is too soft.
That could serve as wadding.
My bore waits to be loaded.
Do not drop food in.
Powder smells better than that.
Set it down; I cannot fetch it.
You struck my carriage.
My muzzle shifted a finger's width.
I held; my wheels moved.
That will need re-aiming.

lines.zh: 你被我的车架挡回来了
lines.en: My carriage pushed you back.
Iron against flesh; you lose.
Do not walk against the barrel.

lines.zh: 我的轮子压到你的脚了吗
lines.en: Did my wheel catch your foot?
The whole gun slid back half an inch.
Go around my carriage.
I am nothing but cast iron.
I cannot give you what you seek.

lines.zh: 但我能替你守住这个炮位
lines.en: But I can hold this emplacement for you.
Sit against me; the iron is cold.

lines.zh: 我会一直朝着那个方向
lines.en: I will keep facing that way.

lines.zh: 你走的时候记得带上火绳
lines.en: Remember the match when you go.
At night the bore ticks once.
That is the iron's own sound.
You need not be afraid of me.
I will not leave here.
You have put it in my bore.
This is not a cannonball.
Too light; it will not carry.
It will jam the bore.
This pile you found will serve.
I press it under my wheel.
Do not leave it on the carriage.
This can shim the breech.
Iron filings have settled on me.
Take it away from here.
Target in arc.
Muzzle elevated half a degree.
The charge is measured.
I aim at the wall's base.
This shot will open a breach.
Wait for my recoil.
Everyone to the sides.
The match is in place.
My breech is seated firm.
No one can hold that wall now.
Light it on the word.
Loading complete.
Muzzle on target.
Everyone in position.
That wall is coming down.
Light it and fire this shot.
I make small corrections to the target.
The muzzle's shadow lies on it.
I wait for it to cross my centreline.
The powder waits in my bore.

lines.zh: 这个角度能打穿两层石
lines.en: From this angle I can break two layers of stone.

lines.zh: 炮架被后坐力推得发抖
lines.en: My carriage trembles at the thought of recoil.
It still hides behind the wall.
Breaking the wall is enough.
I lower my elevation.
One more breath.
The wind has steadied.
The barrel is warming.
It has started to move.
Half a finger of lead is enough.
Sparks fall from the match.
The air in my bore is compressed.
This shot will not wait.
A hum, then the roar.
In this very instant.
Too late; it cannot dodge.
Fire and smoke burst from my muzzle.
The whole gun leaps back half a step.
Stone bursts into fragments.
That sound carries a long way.
A cloud of dust rises where the shot lands.
My carriage is still shaking.
Someone is shouting beside me.
My bore is glowing hot.
The smell of iron drowns the blood.
I need my bore swabbed.
That one flew true.
A breach has opened.
I recoiled half a foot and held.
Give it another shot.
Load, and move quickly.
The smoke has hidden the view.
I do not need to see the result.
It has gone quiet beyond the wall.
I am rolled onto the emplacement.
My barrel is raised first.
My wheels land and bite four holes.
A powder keg is set beside me.
My muzzle faces the wall.
The iron smells cold.

lines.zh: 有人在我身后清点炮弹
lines.en: Someone counts the shot behind me.
My breech sinks into its socket.
I face the whole field.
A match is lit at one end.
I speak for the first time today.

lines.zh: 声还没出来,地已经静了
lines.en: Before the sound, the ground goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我身上的铁锈被擦掉了
lines.en: The rust has been wiped off me.
Every eye turns this way.
The charge is tamped down.
Stand back; I am about to speak.
This shot may begin.
Let that wall listen.
The powder nearly caught.
I tip over, muzzle to the ground.
Water in my bore; the powder is ruined.
Most of my carriage is blown apart.

lines.zh: 一颗弹丸砸在我的炮管上
lines.en: A shot cracks against my barrel.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的炮口自己转
lines.en: That force turns my muzzle on its own.

lines.zh: 没有火药,我就是一块铁
lines.en: Without powder, I am only iron.
Lightning strikes my barrel.
My wheels spin and grip nothing.
